d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, Nepal ke Mustang me Aloo ki ye dish bahut famous hai, jo spicy hoti hai timmur ka masala ke saath banti hai ye Nepali Spicy Chilli Potato hai, waise potato ke wedges cut karke sirf kadhai me sekhna hi hota hai, bahut easily banti hai aur taste super hota hai, crispy aloo ho jata hai aur unpe sichuan peppers ya timmur ka chatpata masala se taste bhai next level hota hai!
Recipe ke item:
Aloo - 5 - prefer low sugar wale kijiega
Oil - 2 tbsp + 1 tbsp
Salt - to taste
Haldi - 1/4 tsp
Garlic - 6-7 chopped
Green chilli - 2
